## 5. Known limitation: 30/360 with a February end-of-month coupon date

36 of 300 random 30/360 cases involve a Feb end-of-month coupon or settlement. Implied-yield difference vs QuantLib: median 1.01 bp, max 7.67 bp. Not resolved which convention a given market data vendor uses; ACT/ACT is unaffected.
